_about: Differences between an empty database built from files and the staging fingerprint that are expected. Anything else fails the replay; an entry that no longer occurs fails too, so this list stays exact.

platformOnlyOnStaging._why: Created by the Supabase platform in every project (event triggers, bundled extensions, supabase_admin defaults, the dashboard auto-RLS event trigger function); not repository objects.

stricterInFiles._why: CHECK/UNIQUE constraints and indexes that repository migrations define but staging never received (its tables pre-dated those CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migrations). Kept: they only reject invalid rows or speed up reads.

pendingOnStaging._why: Objects of migrations merged but not yet applied to staging (group or object keys). Empty whenever staging is up to date; list them only while comparing across such a gap. The 2026-10-10 (Asia/Shanghai) snapshot verifies staging through 0197 (ledger 20261009170545); no pending objects remain for that boundary.
